input.bottom_line: Recorded Sunday 8 Nov, not Monday 9 Nov
input.headline: The video's mains-flicker fingerprint matches Sunday 8 November 2026 at 11:42:39 UTC. That is the stated clock time to within 2 seconds, but one day earlier than claimed.
input.difference: about 24 hours earlier (1 day minus 2 s). The time of day is correct but the date is wrong.
input.what_it_means: The recording appears to have been made at the same time of day as stated, but on Sunday 8 November rather than Monday 9 November. This rules out the explanation that the device clock drifted. The likely explanations are a wrong date, from a mislabel, a clock or date setting error, or a misstatement. The timing evidence does not support the claim that this footage shows 9 November.
findings: The scene is a dark room lit by ceiling strip lights, with no on-screen clock. The light flicker gave a strong grid signal (67% usable). The audio hum was too weak to use (17% usable).
Searching 6 hours around the stated time on 9 Nov, the best match was only 0.84 (11:47:15). That is no better than the 0.83–0.85 that random positions score on any day.
Widening the search to 2–9 Nov produced one clear match: 2026-11-08 11:42:39 UTC, score 0.979. That is 0.13 above every other day.
Analysed separately, the first and second halves of the clip each point to the same start time, within 1 second of each other. This argues against splicing or editing.
The match is sharp: the score drops when the clip is shifted by 10 to 60 seconds, so the timing is precise to a few seconds.
The reference was Elexon's 15-second grid frequency data. The 1-second NESO archive does not cover November 2026.
next_steps: Ask the supplier of the video to explain the date and supply the original file straight from the phone, with its metadata, so the embedded creation date can be compared with this result.
Check whether the events this video is meant to show could have happened on Sunday 8 Nov rather than Monday 9 Nov.
Optionally, confirm against NESO 1-second data once November 2026 is added to that archive.
